Then select exactly one mathematically valid sign observable: a static-patch canonical-energy/current form with declared horizon boundaries, a Taub charge for a declared Nariai Killing generator, or a global mode form with an explicit Euclidean/de Sitter complex structure. Derive the pure-Weyl Lee-Wald residues and compare the Einstein-image and complementary factors invariantly. Close with a scoped mechanism theorem or the first exact obstruction to every declared option, including producer, certificate, independent verifier, mutation tests, schema, report, receipt and atlas fragment.
